facts.text: Sam’s Club says its clubs offer motorized shopping carts and that some also offer manual wheelchairs. Call the Florence club to confirm availability, collection and device fit; this chain policy is not an inspected local equipment inventory.
facts.quote: Our clubs also offer motorized shopping carts for your convenience or should you require mobility assistance. Some clubs also provide manual wheelchairs. Contact your local club for availability.

facts.text: The chain directs members needing shopping or vehicle-loading assistance to the Membership Desk. Confirm the particular help and meeting point with Florence before travelling.
facts.quote: If you are disabled or need assistance with shopping, loading packages into your vehicle, or filling out an employment application, please visit the Membership Desk for assistance.

facts.text: Florence lists daily shopping hours of 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Plus-member early hours of 8–9 a.m. Holiday hours may vary. Early entry is a membership benefit, not a published quiet-hour program.
facts.quote: Club hours Mon - Sun 9am - 8pm Plus membership early hours Mon - Sun 8am - 9am Holiday hours may vary

facts.text: The chain’s curbside FAQ describes online or app ordering, app check-in when ready, designated pickup parking and staff loading the car. Confirm Florence’s selected pickup slot and bay.
facts.quote: With Curbside Pickup, you can shop your club and pick up your order, all without leaving your car. Order online or in the Sam’s Club app. When your order is ready, check in via app, head to the club and park in a Curbside Pickup spot. We’ll even load your car for you.

facts.text: For pickup, the chain FAQ requires the order number and current government-issued photo ID.
facts.quote: What do I need to pick up my order? You’ll need your order number and a current government-issued photo ID.

facts.text: Another person can collect an order if added through Additional Pickup Person before collection. They need the order number and ID.
facts.quote: Can I have someone else pick up my order? Yes. Just enter the person’s name, email address, and phone number during checkout by using the “Additional Pickup Person” feature. When they arrive, they’ll need your order number and an ID. The alternate pickup person may be updated at any time before order pickup.

facts.text: After a checked-in wait exceeding ten minutes, the FAQ directs customers inside to a pickup associate or Membership Desk. Arrange help beforehand if entering would be difficult.
facts.quote: What should I do if it’s been more than 10 minutes since checking in and my order still isn’t here? Please go inside the club and speak with a Curbside Pickup Associate or someone at the Membership Desk about your order.

facts.text: The FAQ gives a pickup hold of up to 24 hours after the scheduled time; later orders may be cancelled. Check the order’s instructions.
facts.quote: We’ll hold your Curbside Pickup order for up to 24 hours after your scheduled pickup time. Orders not picked up within 24 hours are subject to cancellation.

facts.text: Sam’s Club’s TTY/TDD help page says it does not offer assistive-listening telephone lines and offers live chat daily, 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Central time. This is chain support, not Florence’s hearing-equipment inventory or a confirmed curbside check-in alternative.
facts.quote: At this time, Sam's Club does not offer assistive-listening telephone lines. However, you may contact us via live chat 7 days a week from 7am-11pm Central
